_comment: Named reviewers for loan-document pages. SHIPS EMPTY and stays empty until a real, credentialed person has agreed in writing to be listed: never a fabricated, borrowed or placeholder person. Each entry needs name, credential, url (their own public profile) and consent {written: true, date, record} where record says where the signed consent is kept (not a public link). While reviewers is empty, loan-document pages show the editorial-desk line linking /methodology/ and emit no reviewedBy. scripts/validate/reviewer-slot.mjs enforces all of this on the built pages.
